decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention to its own page suggests growing commercial commitment, and a wood-floor soap closely fits the firm's existing flooring knowledge and ability to learn from customers.
Although it did not gain stronger web prominence, maintenance oil is still closely related to the firm's wooden-floor base and can be improved using existing product and user knowledge.
Its promotion to a dedicated page indicates positive early interpretation of market results, and care products for oiled wood floors strongly build on the firm's established flooring expertise.

The product remains only lightly promoted, but as a complementary flooring-system item it is still near enough to the firm's installed-wood-floor knowledge to justify continued learning and portfolio presence.

High-density foam underlay is the least rooted in the firm's core wood-processing knowledge, and the lack of stronger market emphasis suggests limited absorptive capacity to improve or differentiate it.
Oak parquet flooring is the most directly aligned with the firm's longstanding wood capabilities, so management is likely to retain it even if early web visibility stayed modest.
